create.name: Saki Santorelli
create.bio:
Saki Santorelli is a meditation teacher and writer whose practice rests on two traditions. He began studying in the universalist Sufi line of Hazrat Inayat Khan in 1974, and a few years later his teacher, Pir Vilayat Inayat Khan, encouraged him to train in Buddhist insight meditation as well. For most of his working life he was best known for mindfulness-based stress reduction: he led the clinic at the University of Massachusetts Medical School where the programme began, ran its Center for Mindfulness until he retired in 2017, and helped train thousands of MBSR teachers around the world.

Since then he has put his energy into Guest House Awareness, his own platform for spiritual practice. Every Wednesday he gives a free half-hour class on Zoom, recorded and posted afterwards, working through themes such as remembrance, inner archetypes and the real self, usually with music. Members of the paid online community also get monthly sessions, weekly practice suggestions and a chance to talk with him directly. He offers individual and group mentoring based on dialogue and inquiry, which the Sufis call sohbet, and leads silent retreats in Europe and North America with hosting centres.
